howto1p3: Emva koko sahlula isiphumo ngo: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 no-9, ukufikelela inombolo yokuqala.
howto1p4: Ukugqiba iToonleer yosuku ngalunye kuya kukunceda ukuphucula inkcutshe yakho nesantya semathematika yengqondo.
howto2p3: I-cursor iya kuhamba ngokwayo iye kwindawo yokuthwala.

howto4p3: I-cursor iya kuhamba ngokwayo iye kwindawo yokuthwala.
